test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

By the time I reaching / the metro station, / the train had departed.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the first part of the given sentence, the verb form 'reaching' is incorrect.
 
• The correct verb form should be 'reached' to maintain the past perfect tense.
 
• Therefore, the correct form should be 'By the time I reached'.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***By the time I reached __the metro station, the train had departed*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• When using the past perfect tense, ensure that the action that happened first is in the past perfect form, and the action that happened later is in the simple past form.
 
 
• **Example: *By the time we arrived, the concert had started__*__.__**
